thread:
anya: Quick UX pulse: thinking about introducing a "bucket chips" affordance on the p95 heatmap header instead of inline numeric labels. chips open a tiny panel with counts + sample controls. thoughts?
sam: chips could solve clutter. does it scale for >12 buckets?
matt: prototype: chips collapse into a single summary pill when >8, tapping expands an overlay list. fig: https://figma.com/s/bucket-chips-proto
leo: accessibility: overlay must be keyboard-trapable and use role=listbox. chips need 44px hit areas. prefer explicit focus styles over relying on color alone.
aria: SR flow: when chip is focused announce "Bucket 3 of 9: 120 traces, 4% of view". avoid announcing all chips on load. provide a keyboard shortcut ("b") to open the bucket list for quick narration.
katie: copy: call the control "Bucket details" in the tooltip. sample control inside overlay: label as "Trace sample (percent)". microcopy: "Display a representative subset of traces for clarity."
jules: new heuristic idea: auto-suggest sampler levels based on curve variance (e.g., suggest 2% when p95 spike detected). show suggestion as a subtle CTA in overlay.
sam: watch out: auto-suggest must be opt-in. show an explain link: "Why suggested?" that opens a quick tooltip with a line: "High variance -> reduce sample to surface spikes."
matt: implementation notes: prefer accessible HTML overlay (not canvas popouts), use invisible hit padding, support prefers-reduced-motion, and export a compact legend token set.
leo: keyboard spec: Tab to focus chip, Enter to open overlay, arrows to move chips, Enter on chip opens sample slider, arrows adjust 1%, shift+arrow 10%, Escape closes overlay. On apply announce final via aria-live: "Sampling set to 2 percent".
aria: color contrast tweak: chips should have >=4.5:1 text contrast for labels. for tiny color swatches use 2px stroke and high-contrast fallback palette. add a setting "High-contrast heatmap".
anya: OK plan: matt to add bucket-chips frame + overlay to figma, jules to prototype auto-suggestion copy, leo/aria to test keyboard/SR behavior, katie to finalize microcopy. we'll run a 5-min discoverability test after preview.
prod-bot: preview available: https://staging.redwood.ai/bucket-chips-sampler (expires in 48h)
anya: thanks team :thumbsup:
